claim: Spring AI 2.0.0 writes response_format and reasoningEffort into the same OpenAI Chat Completions request.
Spring AI 2.0.0 binds spring.ai.openai.chat.reasoning-effort into OpenAiChatOptions.
google/gemma-4-12b returned valid native JSON and reasoning_content locally with reasoning_effort=low when the output budget was sufficient.
The tested local endpoint supports reasoning and native JSON schema together; a 256-token budget can truncate the final JSON after reasoning.
